description: Fetch who reacted to one post, up to 100 a page: each person's or company page's name, headline and link, and which reaction. With `comment_url`, who reacted to one comment. LinkedIn lists people who react by member id, so `actor.url` is usually a member-id link (`/in/ACoAA…`) with `vanity_name` null; linkedin/profile takes it. Give exactly one of `url` or `comment_url`. Costs 7 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

comment_url.description: A comment's URL: who reacted to that comment.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

url.description: The post's URL, as for linkedin/post.

name: get_linkedin_post_reactions
title: Get who reacted to a LinkedIn post
